Hello,

Re: Flat 13, 73 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ1 6ZZ – job ref R/PM036-1 (broken shower pull knob).

Your landlord has agreed for us to send a contractor to repair the shower knob. We are now arranging a contractor and will be in touch to agree an appointment time with you.

In the meantime, please carry on using the shower carefully. If the problem gets worse, for example the shower can't be turned off or water starts leaking, please let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
